anti_deadlock_rule: Avalon-MM: an agent must eventually deassert waitrequest so a host transfer can complete; Platform Designer's round-robin arbiter guarantees fairness so no host is starved. Avalon-ST: a sink must eventually assert ready so the source can make progress; readyLatency bounds the source's commitment.

fsm_states_avalon_mm.name: IDLE
fsm_states_avalon_mm.description: No transfer; read and write deasserted; waitrequest may be high or low.

fsm_states_avalon_mm.name: CMD
fsm_states_avalon_mm.description: Host drives address + read/write + (writedata/byteenable). The transfer is accepted on a cycle where waitrequest is low.

fsm_states_avalon_mm.name: WAIT
fsm_states_avalon_mm.description: Agent asserts waitrequest; the host holds address/read/write/writedata/byteenable stable (wait-state insertion).

fsm_states_avalon_mm.name: READ_DATA
fsm_states_avalon_mm.description: For fixed latency, readdata is valid readLatency cycles after acceptance; for variable latency, each readdata word is qualified by readdatavalid.

fsm_states_avalon_mm.name: BURST
fsm_states_avalon_mm.description: burstcount transfers move as one burst; beginbursttransfer marks the first cycle; read-burst words are returned with readdatavalid.

fsm_states_avalon_st.name: ST_IDLE
fsm_states_avalon_st.description: Source valid deasserted and/or sink ready deasserted; no beat transferred.

fsm_states_avalon_st.name: ST_XFER
fsm_states_avalon_st.description: Both valid and ready honored per readyLatency; a data beat (symbols) is transferred.

fsm_states_avalon_st.name: ST_SOP
fsm_states_avalon_st.description: startofpacket asserted on the first beat of a packet.

fsm_states_avalon_st.name: ST_EOP
fsm_states_avalon_st.description: endofpacket asserted on the last beat; empty marks unused symbols in the final beat.

fsm_states_avalon_st.name: ST_BACKPRESSURE
fsm_states_avalon_st.description: Sink deasserts ready; the source must not transfer (and, per readyLatency, must hold off valid).

fsm_hints.trigger: Avalon-MM: a transfer begins when the host asserts read or write with a valid address; it completes when waitrequest is low (and for reads, when readdata is returned per latency model).
fsm_hints.rule: The host must hold address/control/writedata stable for the duration of waitrequest; readdata is qualified by readLatency or readdatavalid.
fsm_hints.abort: There is no protocol-level abort; a transfer simply stalls while waitrequest is asserted (or ready is deasserted on Avalon-ST).

exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On reset, hosts deassert read/write (Avalon-MM) and valid (Avalon-ST); sinks may hold ready low until ready to accept. After reset, transfers proceed normally subject to waitrequest / ready backpressure.

default_ready_state_recommendation.mm_idle: read and write deasserted; address/writedata don't-care.
default_ready_state_recommendation.mm_active: Assert read or write with a valid address; hold until waitrequest is low.
default_ready_state_recommendation.st_idle: Source valid deasserted; sink ready reflects acceptance capacity.

configurations.name: Single host / single agent
configurations.description: One Avalon-MM host accessing one agent through interconnect.

configurations.name: Multi-host shared agent
configurations.description: Several hosts share an agent; round-robin arbitration is generated.

configurations.name: Streaming pipeline
configurations.description: Avalon-ST source -> sink chain with adapters inserted as needed.

timing_dependency_rule: All Avalon transfers are synchronous to the interface's Avalon Clock. Avalon-MM read data timing is governed by readLatency (fixed) or readdatavalid (variable); command acceptance is governed by waitrequest. Avalon-ST beat timing is governed by valid/ready and the readyLatency property. Cross-clock-domain connections use generated clock-crossing bridges.
